method: candidate lines proposed by corridor detection; identity decided from printed address runs
why_not_one_block_off: The corridor is lettered 'AVENUE M' in its own roadway on both plates, and the numbered-street address runs put the same hundred-block transition across it on both: west of it the street frontages read 1201 1203 ... 1223 / 1202 1204 ... 1224, east of it they read 1301 1303 ... 1323 / 1302 1304 ... 1324. So this line is the 1200/1300-block break on sheet 51 and on sheet 57 alike. One block EAST is excluded because that corridor is lettered 'AVENUE M 1/2' on both plates (sheet 51 with the outlot-16 N.E./N.W. quarters between M and M 1/2, sheet 57 with the outlot-15 N.E./N.W. quarters) and it carries the 1300/1400 break (1401 1403 1405 / 1402 1404 beyond it). One block WEST is excluded because that corridor is lettered 'AVENUE L' on both plates (sheet 57 roadway native 82.6-292.9; on sheet 51 only its east face survives at native 241.6, the plate edge cutting the rest) and it carries the 1100/1200 break. The block column between Ave L and Ave M is continuous across the shared 27TH ST seam with consecutive block numbers and hundred-block address runs: sheet 51 has block 25 (avenue faces 2509-2528, i.e. 25th-26th) and block 26 (2601-2628, 26th-27th); sheet 57 continues with block 27 (2701-2729, 27th-28th) and block 28 (2801-2822, 28th-29th). Sheet 51's south margin prints '57' as its adjoining plate and sheet 57's own title block reads 57, so the two are genuinely stacked on 27TH ST. Corroboration: the drafted roadway width is the same on both, 211.8 native px on sheet 51 and 211.7 on sheet 57, matching the 70' printed mid-avenue. MEASUREMENT: values are the midpoint of the two facing block lines read off the green native ruler in the band immediately adjacent to the shared 27TH ST seam - sheet 51 faces 1029.1 and 1240.9 (bottom of block 26, just north of 27th St), sheet 57 faces 1087.0 and 1298.7 (top of block 27, just south of 27th St). Sheet 51's raster carries a slight rotation, so Ave M drifts from about 1145.3 at the top of the crop to 1135.0 at the seam (about 0.2 deg); whole-crop averaging instead gives 1141.3 / 1193.3 and an offset of 52.0 rather than 57.9. NOTE: no reported coordinate is a detection candidate - the candidates on both sheets (51: 760/1770/2781, 57: 698/1706/2715) are mid-block lines near the 20-ft alleys (sheet 51 block 26 alley native 602.6-662.9, sheet 57 block 27 alley 659.0-720.8), not avenues.
